mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_pii_purge_log ( pii_purge_log_id, user_type, user_id_hash, purged_at, purge_reason, table_list, legal_basis, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{piiPurgeLogId}, #{userType}, #{userIdHash}, COALESCE(#{purgedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{purgeReason}, #{tableList}, #{legalBasis}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT pii_purge_log_id, user_type, user_id_hash, purged_at, purge_reason, table_list, legal_basis, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_pii_purge_log ORDER BY purged_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
